messages:
maya: Quick design huddle — compact request drilldown: thinking about the placement of the correlation ID and export actions in the compact header. Should the corrID pill sit inline with the metadata or live in the top-right header? Also noticed error badge contrast low in dark mode.
devin: Header feels cleaner — keeps metadata rows consistent across panes. CTAs in header -> predictable spot. For copy text: prefer 'Copy correlation ID' over 'Copy ID'.
sam: From impl perspective header = simpler keyboard/tab order. If we keep it inline we need to add explicit tabindex per row which adds complexity. Also exporting: current button says 'Download' — ambiguous. Suggest dropdown: 'Export trace ▾' -> JSON / CSV.
oliver: +1 on explicit copy wording. For a11y the button should have aria-label="Copy correlation ID to clipboard" and announce success (toast) with role=alert. Small code snippet for aria:
```html
<button class=\"btn-plain\" aria-label=\"Copy correlation ID to clipboard\" onclick=\"copyId()\">Copy</button>
```
linda: Accessibility check: the error badge color ratio in dark theme is ~2.6:1 against background — fails AA. Options: stronger text, add a thin outline, or add an icon + text fallback. Also ensure keyboard focus ring is visible on the pill.
maya: For stack traces in compact view — proposal: collapse long frames into a single "Show 8 more" row that expands inline. Screen reader should get 'button, collapsed, Show 8 more stack frames'.
devin: Good. Copy for that control: 'Show 8 more frames' / 'Hide extra frames' — include aria-expanded toggle.
sam: Performance note: expanding in place is cheap if frames are virtualized, otherwise could cause reflow. We can lazy-render frames on expand.
oliver: One more copy nit: export options currently read 'Export' in menu — make them explicit: 'Export trace (JSON)', 'Export trace (CSV)'. On narrow screens show a single 'Export' icon + overflow menu.
maya: Keyboard ordering for compact header: 1) Copy correlation ID, 2) Export, 3) Share permalink. That order matches most user flows (copy id then export).
linda: Screen reader users expect clear announcements after copy: 'Correlation ID copied to clipboard'. Also ensure the copy button is reachable via screen reader label-only (no visual text) if we use an icon.
sam: Impl detail: permalinks currently generate a tokenized URL; ensure copy action for permalink uses navigator.clipboard.writeText and shows accessible toast.
oliver: Small design tweak: increase hit target for the pill to 36px min, keep visual compactness by reducing padding but not tappable area.
maya: I'll update figma with header variant + collapsed frames. https://www.figma.com/file/example/trace-compact-v2 (mock link)
devin: Can we get a quick dev estimate? sam?
sam: Rough: header move + aria labels + copy behavior ~1d. Export dropdown + CSV option ~1d. Collapsing frames + lazy render ~2d. Accessibility fixes (contrast + focus) ~0.5d. Total ~4.5d.
maya: Thanks — let's prioritize: 1) copy wording + aria, 2) export label clarity, 3) collapsed frames, 4) contrast fix.
devin: I'll add to the next sprint. Quick usability check with 3 non-design folks once mock is in figma.
oliver: tiny: change tooltip text from 'Copy' to 'Copy correlation ID' to avoid ambiguity for assistive tech.
linda: thumbs up for that. :thumbsup:
maya: Cool — I'll push updated screens and copy changes. If anyone spots any other a11y traps call them out here.
devin: Thanks team.
